name: Regions Bank
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public regions.com help pages only (no sign-in; the product pages answer automated reads with a bot check, so fees and rates are not modelled). The mock bill is a Regions unsecured personal loan (help FAQ 'How can I make a payment on my loan or line of credit?'). Payment ways: Online Banking (Regions Loan and Credit Payments, transferring from a Regions deposit account), the mobile app (internal transfer), a branch, phone 1-800-231-7493, regular mail to Regions Consumer Loan Processing, PO Box 71295, Charlotte, NC 28272-1295, overnight to Loan Servicing Dept, 2090 Parkway Office Circle, Hoover, AL 35244, and Automatic Payment Draft set up with a printed Automatic Debit Authorization form (so AutoPay is offline online; the form-only enrollment with a pending state is an open tier-1 request). Questions: 1-800-REGIONS (734-4667). Sign-in uses a username and password (password-reset FAQ: Find your username / Create a new password, Remember Me). Paying from an external bank or card is not described (bank only, inferred).

public.label: How to make a loan payment

autopay.note: Automatic Payment Draft is set up by completing, printing and returning the Automatic Debit Authorization form as its directions explain. For help, call 1-800-231-7493.

guest_pay.note: Regions loan payments are made in Online Banking or the app from a Regions deposit account, at a branch, by phone at 1-800-231-7493 or by mail.

help.title: How to make a loan payment
paragraphs: In Regions Online Banking, choose Regions Loan and Credit Payments and transfer the payment from your Regions deposit account. In the Regions Mobile app, use an internal transfer from your Regions deposit account. You can also pay at any Regions branch or call 1-800-231-7493.

By regular mail, send your payment to Regions Consumer Loan Processing, PO Box 71295, Charlotte, NC 28272-1295. For overnight delivery, use Loan Servicing Dept, 2090 Parkway Office Circle, Hoover, AL 35244.

help.title: Automatic Payment Draft
paragraphs: To have your loan payment drafted automatically, open the Automatic Debit Authorization form, complete and print it, and follow the directions on the form to send it in. Automatic drafts are not set up in Online Banking. Until your draft starts, keep paying by transfer, phone, mail or at a branch.

help.title: Forgot your username or password
paragraphs: On the log in page, choose Find your username to retrieve a forgotten Online Banking username, or Create a new password to reset your password. Check Remember Me when you log in so your username fills in next time.

help.title: Questions about your loan
paragraphs: For questions about your unsecured loan, call 1-800-REGIONS (1-800-734-4667). To pay by phone, call 1-800-231-7493.
